title: Night Signal
about: A storm has cut the town off. Until dawn it has one voice: the radio station June is selling in the morning
ask: Sell the station or go on air?

title: Golden Seam
about: A seaside workshop mends pottery with gold from the last train to the first. Twelve boxes, twelve visitors
ask: Stay, or take the first train?

title: Sticky Rice
about: The night before Korea's biggest exam. A snack bar across from the school feeds everyone who can't sleep — and gives no one advice
ask: Tell Minu the truth before the exam?
